Applies request-scoped external findings before output rendering

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Xberg\Xberg;
use Xberg\ExternalRedactionFinding;
use Xberg\ExtractInput;
use Xberg\RedactionFinding;
$input = \Xberg\ExtractInput::from_json(json_encode(["bytes" => [116, 111, 107, 101, 110, 45, 55, 52, 50, 57, 32, 101, 109, 97, 105, 108, 101, 100, 32, 97, 108, 105, 99, 101, 64, 101, 120, 97, 109, 112, 108, 101, 46, 99, 111, 109, 46], "filename" => "external-findings.txt", "kind" => "bytes", "mimeType" => "text/plain"]));
$result = Xberg::extractWithExternalRedaction($input, [], [ExternalRedactionFinding::from_json('{"label":"inspection_token","score":0.99,"text":"token-7429"}')], "unicode_code_points", 8);
var_dump($result->getResults()[0]->content);
```
